description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common setup such as logging initialization. It extends FragmentActivity and sets up logging infrastructure using custom LogWrapper and standard Android Log utilities.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that extends FragmentActivity to handle common setup tasks for Android sample activities, including initializing logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; currently just calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity becomes visible; calls initializeLogging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain by creating a LogWrapper and directing Log outputs to it.
